title: GPOM Second Half D: The Clean Room and the Crossing
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ second half D: the clean room and the crossing
about: Inside the AI's building: suits, a vast white room with the wafer in the middle, a hundred chairs laid out like a wafer. All hundred power the machine; the AI goes. After: Maddie alone. The boss does not speak in D (Kai round 1): Maddie speaks for him. The plan, the cost and the doubt are settled earlier, in the bunker negotiation scene (not yet written). Stage 1 written brief: brief.md; music: music.md; round-1 notes: cut-notes.json.
stage: 1 (written brief, no interview: the 2026-10-21 autonomous run, second-half-ending-goal.md)

maddie.rule: ALWAYS this reference; the torn bunting stays in every shot
maddie.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)

ai.rule: No body, ever. Silent in scene D after Kai's round 1 (Maddie says every line that was his); his one line left in the ending is E's last line.
ai.voice: Suno Voice "badcode newsreader" (the AI), dry, through Maddie's speaker: small-speaker filter, beacon pulses on his words

building.rule: ONE fixed design: a long, low building of black glass, many times longer than it is tall, with one single thin horizontal seam of warm amber light running its whole length, set down in a fold between two green chalk downs, the only made thing in sight; no windows, no signs, no other lights
building.note: Design anchor = the BL series (BL1-day, BL2-dusk, BL4-seam-opens, BL5-aerial; second-half-moodboard.md). L11-exterior-night is NOT this design (a tall near-cubic block, seam part-way) and is not used.

beats.name: Suits on
beats.blurb: A changing room. A hundred people pull clean-room suits over their jumpers. The hospitality is uncanny and a bit ridiculous.

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.text: Suits on, please. It's a clean room.
lines.how: brisk and cheery, a Bristol local with house rules, a little fussy on her boss's behalf; chatty, never prim or posh
lines.was: AI: same words (Kai round 1, ld1-0: Maddie says it)

lines.speaker: sandra
lines.text: I hope this bloody plan works.
lines.how: worried, quiet, under her breath as she pulls the suit on; not a joke: a frightened woman being brave
lines.was: Five years, one toilet. Now he's fussy. (Kai round 1, ld1-1)
lines.note: 'the plan' is set up in the bunker negotiation scene (not yet written); D does not explain it

beats.name: Into the room
beats.blurb: They come through the doors into a vast white room with the wafer standing in the middle of it. Nobody walks to the centre yet. Spotless: no mud, no prints (they have just come through the clean room).

beats.name: The wafer
beats.blurb: Beside the wafer. Derek asks; Maddie, gleaming clean now with no explanation, tells them what it is and what it costs; the old lady answers for all of them. The emotional height of the film. The physics and 'it only sends one back' are not said here: the bunker scene carries them.

lines.speaker: derek
lines.how: hushed, awed and afraid, barely above a whisper; a man who already half knows the answer, his voice catching slightly

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.text: It's the time machine. You do understand what this will cost you.
lines.how: the most important thing she will ever say, and she knows it: gentle, grave and full of love, no cheek at all; a quiet pause after 'It's the time machine.'; then slow and tender, close to tears but holding it together, almost pleading, every word careful, her voice breaking a little on 'cost you'
lines.was: AI: You wouldn't follow how it works. What it runs on, you already know.

lines.speaker: lady
lines.text: Look, this has been the worst possible outcome for humanity. If there's a chance we could go back in time to change it, I want to take that chance.
lines.how: stern and grave, not soft, not reassuring, no smile: she answers Maddie as if her life depends on it, because it does; low, firm and deliberate, every word meant; 'Look,' sharp, then a breath; 'the worst possible outcome for humanity' hard and heavy; a short pause; 'I want to take that chance' slow and final, falling at the end
lines.was: Us. (then AI: You. And your consciousness. / It only sends one back. Me. -- both cut, Kai round 1 bd3)

beats.name: A hundred chairs
beats.blurb: Overhead, the hundred chairs laid out like a wafer. On each one, a blanket and a cup of tea.

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.how: helpful and chirpy, entirely unaware it is creepy; a delivery robot proud of her records
lines.was: AI: same words (Kai round 1, ld4-1: Maddie says it)
lines.previous_text: Milk, two sugars. I kept your loyalty cards.
lines.cut_note: Kai reel at2525 (23 Oct): 'I kept your loyalty cards.' cut

cut_lines.speaker: lady
cut_lines.cut: Kai at2347 (reel round 1, 23 Oct): dropped; Maddie just tells her

beats.name: Up your sleeve
beats.blurb: Derek tests it. The machine cannot prove it, and says so, in Maddie's words from the door. Derek asks the plain question, does it even work, and it admits it does not know. Then Derek sits down first: trust given by an act, and the room follows.
beats.cut: Kai round 1 (bd5): the test is cut; the doubt is dealt with in the bunker scene.

lines_cut.speaker: derek
lines_cut.text: How do I know this isn't one of your simulations?

lines_cut.speaker: ai
lines_cut.voice: Suno Voice "badcode newsreader" (the AI), dry, through Maddie's speaker: small-speaker filter, beacon pulses on his words
lines_cut.text: You don't. You go on your feelings.
lines_cut.how: plain, unhurried, no point-scoring; Maddie's concession from scene B's door, word for word bar one
lines_cut.pays_off: scene B, Maddie: "You can't. There's nothing I can say that proves it. I'm a robot. You're the conscious ones. You'll just have to go on your feelings."
lines_cut.previous_text: You don't. Believing it is your bit.
lines_cut.note_round3: Kai (23 Oct): reworded to echo B's changed line. The beat (d5) is CUT, so it is not voiced: an AI line is a Suno take, and it would only be recorded if d5 comes back.

lines_cut.speaker: derek
lines_cut.how: flat, blunt, looking down at the robot; the question nobody has asked
lines_cut.was: Then say you don't know. (review round 2: heard as an echo of "You don't", a quiz not a point; replaced by one plain question about the machine)
lines_cut.was_r1: Got anything else up your sleeve? (review round 1: the callback to a line scene A's cut does not contain; replaced so Derek wins a point, 4.12)

lines_cut.speaker: ai
lines_cut.voice: Suno Voice "badcode newsreader" (the AI), dry, through Maddie's speaker: small-speaker filter, beacon pulses on his words
lines_cut.text: I don't know if it works.
lines_cut.how: a beat, then conceding the point (scene B's "Fair."); honest, quiet; the one time he admits not knowing (trust test 4.12)
lines_cut.was: No. This is all of it. I don't know if it works.
lines_cut.planned: ...Fair. Nothing up my sleeve. I don't know if it works. (atom gpom-sh-end-ai-d6r, Suno round C: generated, not recordable on 22 Oct; swap in when it records)

beats.name: They sit
beats.blurb: They sit, every one of them; nobody makes them. The old lady asks what he will do when he gets back, and Maddie says it as plainly as it can be said.

lines.speaker: lady
lines.text: When he arrives back in time, what will he do?
lines.how: lying back in the chair, quiet, matter-of-fact, genuinely wanting to know, a little hope in it
lines.was: What'll you tell them? Back then.

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.text: He's going to try and convince you lot to sort your government out.
lines.how: plain and clear, as simple as she can make it, every word distinct; fond, a little wry on 'you lot'; sincere: the whole plan in one sentence
lines.was: AI: That the companies cutting the jobs kept the gains. And you paid.

beats.name: Seat down
beats.blurb: Two hands across the gap between two chairs. The last joke, and the goodbye.

lines.speaker: sandra
lines.text: Does this mean I get to hang out with non-grumpy Derek?
lines.how: soft and teasing, lying back in the chair, fond; a smile in her voice holding back tears; the joke is how she says goodbye
lines.was: Did you put the seat down? (the seat joke is done in C, Kai round 1 ld7-0)

lines.speaker: derek
lines.text: Yes, love. Are you ready for this?
lines.how: warm, a small breath of a laugh on 'Yes, love'; then quieter and tender, serious, holding her hand: 'Are you ready for this?'

beats.name: The crossing
beats.blurb: Opens on the 'they sit' shot again (D10n, everyone in a chair), the lights come up. The light, the hands go slack, out to the prints at the door and the seam going dark. No explosion.

beats.name: After: Maddie alone
beats.blurb: The music carries on from d8. Straight to Maddie, gleaming, small among a hundred empty chairs, from the same angle as the opening of d8. She calls her boss, and nobody answers.

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.how: small and quiet, expecting an answer that does not come; trailing off; a long silence after it
lines.note: the long pause after it is placed in the edit

beats.moved: '...Mind how you go.' moves to E01, said whole through the phone (Kai round 1, ld9-1)
